beats_top.why: The #1 result is a 2022 news feature with no current hours, addresses, fares or free-food options. Ours answers in the first paragraph by car/no-car situation and adds current addresses, hours, fare rules and pantries.
changes: Replace the unsupported 'Route 15 runs weekdays only' claim with what the Sun says: about once an hour on weekdays, weekend service not stated
Check Trader Joe's and Aldi on their own sites and add address and hours

fixes: In the Fares 'Our advice' paragraph, replace 'the Sun says Route 15 runs weekdays only' with 'the Sun said in 2022 that Route 15 ran about once an hour on weekdays and did not describe weekend service; confirm on TCAT's timetable (https://tcatbus.com) that it runs when you plan to go'.

In Common mistakes, change 'Assuming Route 15 runs when you want to shop. The Sun says it is weekdays only.' to 'Assuming Route 15 runs when you want to shop. The 2022 Sun described hourly weekday service; check TCAT for weekends and evenings.'
